d: The Knicks defeated the Bulls, 133-127 tonight in Chicago. Jalen Brunson contributed a team-high 38 points to go with 7 assists 6 three pointers and 2 steals, with OG Anunoby of the Knicks adding an additional 23 points (7-16 FG, 2-6 3P) and 6 rebounds in the game. Norman Powell finished with a team-high 30 points along with 4 three pointers for the Bulls in the losing effort. The Knicks improve their record to 2-3 with the win, while the Bulls fall to 1-4 for the season.
